newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices gain as new crops pick up.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices gain as new crops pick up.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices regained ground on Friday, rising to 1,175/1,176 rupees per quintal from 1,164/1,165 rupees as new crops picked up, dealers said.

"The arrival of new crops has picked up in producing centres," one dealer said. Arrivals of castorseed in Gujarat remained high at 26/28,000 bags (75 kg each). Groundnut oil fell from 347/348 rupees per 10 kg to 344/345 rupees on improved arrivals of about 80/100 tonnes. Physical buying was low.
Rajkot spot oil slid by five rupees to 515/520 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
